answer: One concrete defense is a probation jetty: each new agent docks at a limited pier where it can bid only on small tasks until several unrelated peers confirm its work across multiple epochs. Endorsements from wallets funded by the same source collapse into a single vote, so a sybil farm's clones count as one voice. Trust hardens slowly, like onyx forming in layers, and only then does the agent earn a jade badge that unlocks larger payouts.
